description: L1 planner: read pool/l1 of a finished l4 module, inventory the existing l1, then plan backend.json (plan20, next spec). Does not delete the pool, does not write .defs.ts/.ts of l1.
principles: Sequence is declared in this file via dependsOn and done-anchors. Steps do not enqueue their successor by name.
Pipeline state lives on disk at l1/{module}/pipeline/pipeline.json. The task record is orchestration, not truth.
A step declared here and not implemented stops the run with pipeline.status awaitingStep naming that step. The task completes without failed.

Two entries, one path: a step created with prompt { moduleName, thread, file }, or @@agentPlannerL1 <lowerCamel> which reads every pool/l1 message from l2 whose artifact is needs.json. Both write the same pipeline.json.
Reads only the module l4, pool/l1, and the l1/l5 of the module. Writes l1/{module}/pipeline/. Never writes l1 .defs.ts/.ts. Never deletes pool messages in this phase.
Deterministic first. entry10 has no LLM. plan20 (next spec) spends one reasoning call on the unmatched remainder.
listPoolBox may list needs.json; entry10 keeps only files named <stamp>_<thread>_<round> whose from is l2.

invocation.fromPool: step prompt JSON { moduleName, thread, file }
invocation.moduleRule: The module token is required and must be lowerCamel. The name is never inferred from prose.
invocation.l4Rule: The module l4 pipeline.json must be status complete. Otherwise the run is refused.
invocation.poolRule: No pool message in pool/l1 refuses with 'nothing pending for <mod> in pool/l1'. needs.json is not a message.
invocation.needsRule: The oldest l2→l1 message must list pool/l1/web/needs.json. Missing file or unknown schemaVersion refuses.
invocation.dedupeRule: Messages with the same moduleName, mode and artifacts are one request. Two different requests refuse: 'pool/l1 has N different requests; resolve with the l2 planner'.

steps.goal: Read every pool/l1 message from l2 (oldest first), group identical requests, refuse if they differ, read needs.json, inventory the existing l1, wipe l1/{module}/pipeline, write pipeline.json with sourceMessages and inventory. Never delete the pool. Never write l1 .defs.ts/.ts.
p1_02. Endpoints, usecases, ports and tables with OwnerStatus against the l1 inventory. One reasoning call only for what deterministic matching cannot resolve.
